Средняя цена за 50 / 200 последних свече: Average price over the last 50 / 200 candles, recent candles weigh more. Price above EMA 200 — usually an uptrend.
Средняя цена с учётом объёма от выбранно: Volume-weighted average price from a chosen point: «the average price participants paid since then».
Средний размах свечи (ход цены за период: Average candle range (price movement per period). Helps choose a stop: a stop shorter than one ATR is usually knocked out by random noise.
Объём относительно обычного: ×2 — вдвое: Volume relative to normal: ×2 — twice the average. Breakouts on high volume are more often genuine.
Накопленная разница рыночных покупок и п: Cumulative difference between market buys and sells. Rising — buyers are more aggressive, falling — sellers.
Плата между лонгами и шортами на бессроч: Payment between longs and shorts on perpetual futures every 8 h. Positive — longs pay (there are more of them), negative — shorts. +0.01% on Binance is normal.
Сколько всего открыто фьючерсных позиций: How many futures positions are open in total. Rising together with price — new money is driving the move.
Принудительное закрытие позиций с плечом: Forced closing of leveraged positions when the loss has eaten the collateral. The map shows where many of them are (estimated from exchange data).
Участок резкого движения, где цена прошл: A sharp move where price passed with almost no two-way trading; price often returns to it.
Насколько BTC на Coinbase дороже, чем на: How much more BTC costs on Coinbase than on Binance. Positive — stronger buying in the US.
